text.en:
There is hereby created a decoratipn,
to be known as the ORDER OF THE GRIEVING HURT, to
be awarded by the President of the Philippines to
Filipino citizens, as well as to foreign nationals,
who have lost their lives in rendering outstanding
voluntary services for the cause of humanity.

The ORDER OF THS GRIEVING HART shall
be as follows:
The Heart in GULES (red) on top a cross
in ARGENT (silver); crowned by laurel wreath
in VIRIE (green); on top a sampaguita laurel
in ARGEND VERTE (Silver and green) clasping
a moire red ribbon 1½ inch in width.

The decoration of the OFDDR OF THD
GRIEVING HART shall be awarded posthumously to any
person entitled thereto, in which case the same shall
be received by his legal heirs; if there be no lea
gal heirs, by his nearest of king and if there be
no heir or nearest of kin, by any person designated
by the Fresident, or the Secretery of Foreign Af-
fairs, acting by authority of the President, to
receive the award on behalf of the deceased.
SDC. 4. The Philippines Heraldry Committee is
directed to prepare the design and svecifications
for the decoration, subject to the approval of the
